content.title: Reds Hall of Famer announced as Findlay Market Opening Day Parade grand marshal
content.text: Skip to contentCINCINNATI (WXIX) - The grand marshal for the 106th Findlay Market Opening Day Parade is Reds great Chris Sabo.Sabo was a three-time All-Star for the Reds.The 1988 Rookie of the Year spent seven seasons with Cincinnati. Sabo was a member of the 1990 World Series champion Reds.[Watch more from FOX19 NOW]An honorary grand marshal will be on hand for the March 27 parade.The Reds will play in the 2025 MLB Speedway Classic at Bristol. The Reds and Atlanta Braves will play inside the famous NASCAR venue.And what better way to celebrate that game than by having a member of the NASCAR on FOX family join Cincinnati’s Opening Day festivities?Two-time Daytona 500 winner Michael Waltrip will serve as the honorary grand marshal for the Findlay Market Opening Day Parade.Opening Day is March 27. The parade starts at 12 p.m.More than 160 entries, including 16 marching bands and nearly 50 horses, will take part in this year’s parade.See a spelling or grammatical error in our story?
